portal_hypertension.title: The diagnosis and management of portal hypertension in cirrhosis: The Gastroenterological Society of Australia consensus.
portal_hypertension.studyType: Journal Article / Consensus Statement / Practice Guideline
portal_hypertension.authors: Majumdar A, Holmes J, Roberts SK
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：在澳大利亚，慢性肝病目前是导致 50 至 59 岁人群过早死亡的第三大原因，也是澳大利亚 35 至 70 岁所有其他 5 岁年龄组中的第四大原因。 临床提示：国家卫生保健最高组织澳大利亚胃肠病学会 (GESA) 制定了关于肝硬化患者门脉高压的诊断和治疗的共识声明
portal_hypertension.abstract: In Australia, chronic liver disease is now the third leading cause of premature death in people aged 50-59 years, and the fourth leading cause in all other 5-year age groups from 35 to 70 years in Australia. A consensus statement on the diagnosis and management of portal hypertension in patients with cirrhosis was developed by the Gastroenterological Society of Australia (GESA), the peak national organization for health care professionals and researchers working in gastroenterology and hepatology, to provide contemporary, evidence-based clinical guidelines. A summary of its recommendations is presented here. The consensus statement was developed in accordance with the Appraisal of Guidelines...

portal_hypertension.title: The Importance of Liver-Lung Communication in Pulmonary Vascular Diseases.
portal_hypertension.authors: Singh N, DuBrock HM, Prisco SZ
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：在正常健康状况下，肝脏和肺具有密切的解剖学、生理学和功能关系。 临床提示：然而，在肺血管疾病的背景下，越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物组、肝系统和肺血管系统（所谓的“肠-肝-肺”轴）之间的相互作用发挥着重要作用。
portal_hypertension.abstract: In normal health, the liver and lungs enjoy a close anatomic, physiologic, and functional relationship. In the context of pulmonary vascular disease, however, there is accumulating evidence that the interplay between the gut microbiome, hepatic system, and pulmonary vasculature (so-called "gut-liver-lung" axis) plays an important role in driving disease pathogenesis and determining clinical outcomes. Despite recognizing the importance of the gut-liver-lung axis in pulmonary vascular disease however, little is known about the clinical characteristics, circulating factors, and physiologic pathways that mediate this important axis of communication. portal_hypertension.title: Non-selective beta-blockers control ascites and improve outcomes in cirrhotic patients with first episode of ascites.
portal_hypertension.journal: Hepatobiliary & pancreatic diseases international : HBPD INT
portal_hypertension.authors: Fernández-Soro A, Lobo-Antuña V, Alventosa-Mateu C
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 99）。核心观点：在代偿性肝硬化患者中使用非选择性β受体阻滞剂（NSBB）已被证明可以降低首次失代偿的风险。 临床提示：然而，它们在初始水压失代偿后的作用尚不清楚。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The use of non-selective beta-blockers (NSBBs) in patients with compensated cirrhosis has been shown to reduce the risk of first decompensation. However, their role after initial hydroptic decompensation is not clearly defined. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical evolution of patients with cirrhosis after the first episode of ascites. Inpatients with first decompensation in the form of ascites between January 2013 and January 2023 were included. Clinical variables and outcomes were compared between patients treated with and without NSBBs. A total of 99 patients were included, of whom 47 (47.5%) received NSBBs. portal_hypertension.title: Schistosoma japonicum infection: clinical significance of ultrasound findings.
portal_hypertension.journal: Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene
portal_hypertension.authors: Richter J, Wu HW, Ning A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：日本血吸虫感染可引起与门静脉高压相关的严重肝脏并发症，可能导致食管静脉曲张出血而死亡。 临床提示：超声检查（美国）能够识别两种不同类型的金黄色葡萄球菌肝纤维化特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Schistosoma japonicum infection can cause severe hepatic complications associated with portal hypertension, which may lead to death by bleeding from esophageal varices. Ultrasonography (US) enables the identification of two different types of liver fibrosis characteristic for S. japonicum infection: interseptal fibrosis (ISF) and portal fibrosis (PF). To date, these two forms of liver fibrosis have not been sufficiently investigated with regard to their potential to cause portal hypertension. Among the 121 reports published, only 56 (46.3%) distinguish between ISF and PF.
